title: A path cylinder is an affine subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $P$ be a path on the $n$ binary coordinates. The set of binary vectors agreeing with all values fixed by $P$ is the affine subspace consisting of the path's base vector plus the subspace of vectors that vanish on every coordinate fixed by $P$.
